I'll compute the sum of the decimal digits of 50! to verify the result.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Calculate 50!
factorial_50 = math.factorial(50)
print(f"50! = {factorial_50}")

# Convert to string to get digits
digits_str = str(factorial_50)
print(f"Number of digits: {len(digits_str)}")

# Sum the digits
digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in digits_str)
print(f"Sum of digits: {digit_sum}")

# Verify by showing individual digits
print(f"\nDigits: {' + '.join(digits_str)} = {digit_sum}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

The computation confirms that the sum of the decimal digits of 50! is **216**.

ANSWER: 216
